newsitem.title: USA: Israeli leader leaves after White House summit.
newsitem.headline: Israeli leader leaves after White House summit.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu left Washington on Wednesday night after a two-day White House summit with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, Jordan's King Hussein and President Bill Clinton.
The crisis meeting was called by Clinton in an effort to save the Middle East peace process from collapse after resumption of bloody and widespread Israeli-Palestinian violence last week.

The summit ended with few concrete results apart from agreement by Netanyahu and Arafat that mid-level negotiations on the issues unsettled in Washington would resume on the Israeli-Gaza border on Sunday.
